ObjectProcedure.Name: incident_routing
ObjectProcedure.Content:
<?
 
/*
* CPMObjectEventHandler: incident_routing
* Package: RN
* Objects: Incident
* Actions: Create, Update
* Version: 1.4
*/
 
// This object procedure binds to v1_1 of the Connect PHP API
use \RightNow\Connect\v1_4 as RNCPHP;
 
// This object procedure binds to the v1 interface of the process
// designer
use \RightNow\CPM\v1 as RNCPM;

/**
* An Object Event Handler must provide two classes:
* - One with the same name as the CPMObjectEventHandler tag
* above that implements the ObjectEventHandler interface.
* - And one of the same name with a "_TestHarness" suffix
* that implements the ObjectEventHandler_TestHarness interface.
*
* Each method must have an implementation.
*/
 
class incident_routing implements RNCPM\ObjectEventHandler {
	public static function apply( $run_mode, $action, $obj, $n_cycles ) {
		try {
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Source: %s, ID: %s", $obj->Source->ID, $obj->ID));
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Contact ID: %s, Email: %s", $obj->PrimaryContact->ID, $obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address));
		    /* Source ID Definitions
		       Lvl1: 32002, Lvl2: 1017 = CX Console, Live Chat
		       Lvl1: 32002, Lvl2: 1001 = CX Console, Incident Editor
		       Lvl1: 32002, Lvl2: 1002 = CX Console, Contact Editor
		       Lvl1: 32004, Lvl2: 3001 = End-User page, Ask A Question
		       Lvl1: 32004, Lvl2: 3019 = End-User page, End-User Connect
		       Lvl1: 32006, Lvl2: 5001 = Utilities, Techmail - Service Mailbox */
			$org_id = NULL;
			$org_object = NULL;
			$is_am = false;
		    if ($obj->Source->ID == 5001) {  // Techmail
				$email_not_registered = true;
				if ($obj->PrimaryContact->Organization) {
					$email_not_registered = false;
				}
		    	$techSupportMailbox = RNCPHP\Configuration::fetch( 'CUSTOM_CFG_MAILBOX_TECH_SUPPORT' )->Value;
		    	$accountManagementMailbox = RNCPHP\Configuration::fetch( 'CUSTOM_CFG_MAILBOX_ACCOUNT_MANAGEMENT' )->Value;

		    	if (($obj->Mailbox->ID == $techSupportMailbox) || ($obj->Mailbox->ID == $accountManagementMailbox)) {
		    		$incident_subject = $obj->Subject;
           			if(count($obj->Threads) > 0) {
           				$mailHeader = $obj->Threads[0]->MailHeader;
 		    			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Count: %s, Thread: %s", count($obj->Threads), print_r($obj->Threads[0], true)));	
 		    			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("mailHeader: %s", $mailHeader));	
 		    			if ($mailHeader) {
							$incsub_regex = '/^Subject:(?P<incsub>.*)/im';
							preg_match($incsub_regex, $mailHeader, $isubmatches);
	 		    			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("isubmatches Count: %s", count($isubmatches)));	
							if (count($isubmatches) > 0) {	
								$incident_subject = $isubmatches['incsub'];
								IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Email Subject: %s", $incident_subject));			
							} 
						}
          			}

		    		IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Subject: %s ::: %s", $obj->Subject, $incident_subject));	
		    		$increfnumber = NULL;
					$incref_regex = '/(?P<incref>\d\d\d\d\d\d-\d\d\d\d\d\d)/i';
					preg_match($incref_regex, $incident_subject, $irmatches);
					if (count($irmatches) > 0) {	// this is a response to a closed incident (past MYQ_REOPEN_DEADLINE) (Technical Support [180806-000012])
						$increfnumber = $irmatches['incref'];
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Incident ReferenceNumber: %s", $increfnumber));			
					} 
					$custnum_regex = '/(^|\D)(?P<custnum>\d\d\d\d\d?\d?\d?)($|\D)/i';   // had to make sure the number was not part of [180806-000012]
					preg_match($custnum_regex, str_replace($increfnumber, '', $obj->Subject), $matches);
					$custnum = NULL;
					if (count($matches) > 0) {
						// found customer number in subject
						$custnum = $matches['custnum'];
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("custnum: %s", $custnum));			
						$res = RNCPHP\ROQL::query( "SELECT ID FROM Organization Where CustomFields.c.customer_number = '" . $custnum . "'" )->next();
						if ($row = $res->next()) {
							if (is_numeric($row['ID'])) {
								$org_id  = intval($row['ID']);
								IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("custnum org: %s", $org_id));			
							}
						}
					}
					
					if (!$org_id && $increfnumber) {
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Incident Reference Number: %s", $increfnumber));			
						$irres = RNCPHP\ROQL::query( "SELECT CustomFields.CO.Org.ID FROM Incident WHERE ReferenceNumber = '" . $increfnumber . "'" )->next();
						if ($irrow = $irres->next()) {
							if (is_numeric($irrow['ID'])) {
								$org_id  = intval($irrow['ID']);
								IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("increfnumber org: %s", $org_id));			
							}
						}
					}

					IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Cust Number: %s, OrgID: %s", $custnum, $org_id));	
					if ($custnum && $org_id) {
						// we must do a check against Siebel for any errors like Support Hold
						$tempaccounts = self::getAccounts($obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $custnum, false);
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, "accounts: ".$tempaccounts['error_number']);
						if (!empty($tempaccounts['error_number'])) {
							self::handleRejects($obj, $custnum, $tempaccounts['error_number'], $tempaccounts['error_string'], false, false, false);
							return;
						}
					}
		
					//if (!$org_id) {
						// only lookup accounts if we didn't find the org 
						$allaccounts = self::getAccounts($obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, '', false);
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("allaccounts #: %s", count($allaccounts)));			
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("allaccounts: %s", print_r($allaccounts, true)));			
						if (!empty($allaccounts['error_number'])) {
							self::handleRejects($obj, $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number, $allaccounts['error_number'], $allaccounts['error_string'], $email_not_registered, false, false);
							return;
						}
						if (count($allaccounts) == 0) {
							// if 0 accounts then reject, I don't think this should be possible
							self::handleRejects($obj, NULL, NULL, NULL, $email_not_registered, true, false);
							return;
						}

						$contact_id = $obj->PrimaryContact->ID;
						$index = 0;
						$is_admin = 0;
						foreach ($allaccounts as $account)
						{ 
							$no_chat = 0;
							if ($account['no_chat'] == 'Y') 
							{
								$no_chat = 1;
							}
							if ($account['is_admin'] == 'Y') 
							{
								$is_admin = 1;
							}
							$account_org_id = self::createUpdateOrg(html_entity_decode(str_replace("'","'",$account['name'])), $account['customer_number'], $no_chat, $account['sp_system_type'], $account['siebel_status']);
							if (count($allaccounts) == 1) {
								$org_id = $account_org_id;
								IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("One org found: %s", $org_id));
							}
							if ($index == 0) {
								self::createContactOrgJoin($contact_id, $account_org_id, 1);
								self::updateContact($contact_id, $account_org_id, $is_admin);
							}
							else {
								self::createContactOrgJoin($contact_id, $account_org_id, 0);
							}
							$index++;
						}
					//}
					IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("OrgID: %s", $org_id));			
					
					if ($org_id) {
						// must set the assign and set the queue (PMS, WF, SA)
						$orgres = RNCPHP\ROQL::queryObject( "SELECT Organization FROM Organization Where ID = " . $org_id )->next();
						if ($orgresult = $orgres->next()) {
							//if ($orgresult->CustomFields->c->no_chat) {	// if no chat then we deny
							//	self::handleRejects($obj, NULL, NULL, NULL, true, false, false);
							//	return;
							//}
							IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Getting OrgID: %s", $org_id));			
							$org_object = $orgresult;
							$obj->CustomFields->c->org_id_temp = $orgresult->ID;
							$obj->CustomFields->c->org_label_temp = $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number." ".$orgresult->Name;
							$obj->CustomFields->CO->Org = $orgresult;
							IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Email: %s, Cust Number: %s", $obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number));
							if (($obj->Mailbox->ID == $techSupportMailbox) && ($orgresult->CustomFields->CO->SupportAssigned)) {
								$obj->AssignedTo = new RNCPHP\GroupAccount();
								$obj->AssignedTo->Account = $orgresult->CustomFields->CO->SupportAssigned;
							}
							if (($obj->Mailbox->ID == $accountManagementMailbox) && ($orgresult->CustomFields->CO->AMAssigned)) {
								$obj->AssignedTo = new RNCPHP\GroupAccount();
								$obj->AssignedTo->Account = $orgresult->CustomFields->CO->AMAssigned;
							}
							if ($obj->Mailbox->ID == $accountManagementMailbox) {
								$is_am = true;
							}
							$obj->save(RNCPHP\RNObject::SuppressAll);
						}
					}
					IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Default email_not_registered: %s", $email_not_registered));	

					if (!$org_object && !$obj->Queue) {
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, "Set to Unknown Accounts Queue");
						if ($obj->Mailbox->ID == $accountManagementMailbox) {
							$obj->Queue->ID = 21;			// set to Unknown Accounts Queue - AM  bjh
						}
						else {
							$obj->Queue->ID = 22;			// set to Unknown Accounts Queue - TS
						}
			        	$obj->CustomFields->c->incident_routing_outcome = new RNCPHP\NamedIDLabel();
						$obj->CustomFields->c->incident_routing_outcome->ID = 64;		// Success
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, "Updating Incident");
						$obj->save();
					}
				}
		    }
		    else if ($obj->Source->ID == 3001) {	// AAQ
				$res = RNCPHP\ROQL::query( "SELECT CustomFields.c.org_id_temp FROM Incident Where ID = " . $obj->ID )->next();
				if ($row = $res->next()) {
					if (is_numeric($row['org_id_temp'])) {
						$org_id  = intval($row['org_id_temp']);
					}
				}

				if ($org_id) {
					// must set the assign and set the queue (PMS, WF, SA)
					$orgres = RNCPHP\ROQL::queryObject( "SELECT Organization FROM Organization Where ID = " . $org_id )->next();
					if ($orgresult = $orgres->next()) {
						$org_object = $orgresult;
						IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Email: %s, Cust Number: %s", $obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number));
						$accounts = self::getAccounts($obj->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number, false);
						//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, "accounts: ".print_r($accounts, true));
						if (!empty($accounts['error_number'])) {
							self::handleRejects($obj, $orgresult->CustomFields->c->customer_number, $accounts['error_number'], $accounts['error_string'], false, false, false);
							return;
							//$obj->Subject = "Login Error: ".$accounts['error_number'];
							//$obj->save(RNCPHP\RNObject::SuppressAll);
						}
						else {
							// $obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID
							//  	Technical Support 31
							//  	Account Management Inquiry 25
							//  	Change Request Form 30
							//  	Product Inquiry 29
							//  	Sales/Quote Request 28
							//      Billing Question 26
							//		Label/Supplies Orders 27
							//  	Other 32
							// $obj->CustomFields->c->change_request_type->ID
							// 		CSC User Management 53
							// 		Equipment Relocation Request 54
							//		Vial Conversion Process Request 55
							if ( 
								($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 31) || ($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 32)
								|| (($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 30) && ($obj->CustomFields->c->change_request_type->ID == 53))
                                || (($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 30) && ($obj->CustomFields->c->change_request_type->ID == 74))
							) {
								if ($orgresult->CustomFields->CO->SupportAssigned) {
									$obj->AssignedTo = new RNCPHP\GroupAccount();
									$obj->AssignedTo->Account = $orgresult->CustomFields->CO->SupportAssigned;
								}
							}
							if (
								($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 25) || ($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 29) 
								|| ($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 28)
								|| (($obj->CustomFields->c->incident_type->ID == 30) && (($obj->CustomFields->c->change_request_type->ID == 54) || ($obj->CustomFields->c->change_request_type->ID == 55)))
							) {
								if ($orgresult->CustomFields->CO->AMAssigned) {
									$obj->AssignedTo = new RNCPHP\GroupAccount();
									$obj->AssignedTo->Account = $orgresult->CustomFields->CO->AMAssigned;
								}
								$is_am = true;
							}
						}
					}		
				}
		    }

		    if ($org_object && !$obj->Queue) {
				IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("org_object: %s, sp_system_type: %s, is_am: %s", $org_object->ID, $org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID, $is_am));
				IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("CustomFields: %s", print_r($org_object->CustomFields->c, true)));
		    	if ($org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID == 20) {   // PMS
		    		$obj->Queue = new RNCPHP\NamedIDLabel();
		    		if ($is_am) {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 14;
		    		}
		    		else {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 8;
		    		}
		    	}
		    	else if ($org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID == 21) {   // WF
		    		$obj->Queue = new RNCPHP\NamedIDLabel();
		    		if ($is_am) {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 16;
		    		}
		    		else {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 10;
		    		}
		    	}
		    	else if ($org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID == 22) {   // SA
		    		$obj->Queue = new RNCPHP\NamedIDLabel();
		    		if ($is_am) {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 18;
		    		}
		    		else {
		    			$obj->Queue->ID = 12;
		    		}
		    	}
		    	else if ($org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID == 23) {   // HMS
					self::handleRejects($obj, NULL, NULL, NULL, true, false, true);
					return;
		    	}
		    	else if ($org_object->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->ID == 24) {   // TPMS
					self::handleRejects($obj, NULL, NULL, NULL, true, false, true);
					return;
		    	}
		    }
        	$obj->CustomFields->c->incident_routing_outcome = new RNCPHP\NamedIDLabel();
			$obj->CustomFields->c->incident_routing_outcome->ID = 64;		// Success
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, "Updating Incident");
			$obj->save();
		}
		catch (RNCPHP\ConnectAPIError $err)  
		{
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Exception Code: %s, Message: %s", $err->getCode(), $err->getMessage()));
			//throw $err;
		}
		return;
	} // apply()

	public static function handleRejects($incident, $custnum, $error_number, $error_string, $error_email, $error_cust_number, $error_sp_type)
    { 
		$subject = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_SUBJECT' )->Value;
		IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Error Cust: %s, Error Email: %s, Error Number: %s", $error_cust_number, $error_email, $error_number));

        $body = "Error Number: $error_number, Error Message: $error_string";
        if ($error_cust_number && $error_email) {
        	//$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_BOTH' )->Value;
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_EMAIL' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_cust_number) {
        	//$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_CUSTOMER_NUMBER' )->Value;
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_EMAIL' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_sp_type) {
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_SP_TYPE' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_number == 100) {
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_EMAIL' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_number == 200) {
        	$body = sprintf(RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_MISMATCH' )->Value, $incident->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $custnum);
        }
        else if ($error_number == 300) {
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_SIEBEL_300' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_number == 400) {
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_SUPPORT_HOLD' )->Value;
        }
        else if ($error_email) {
        	$body = RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_EMAIL' )->Value;
        }
        $body = sprintf(RNCPHP\MessageBase::fetch( 'CUSTOM_MSG_REJECT_TEMPLATE' )->Value, $body);
		//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Email: %s, Subject: %s, Body: %s", $incident->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address, $subject, $body));
    	self::sendEmail(array($incident->PrimaryContact->Emails[0]->Address), $subject, $body, $incident);
		$incident->destroy();
    }

    /**
     * Sends an email notification to the assessor
     * @param type $obj
     * @return boolean
     */
    public static function sendEmail($emailArray, $subject, $text_body, $incident) {

        $mm = new RNCPHP\MailMessage();
        $mm->To->EmailAddresses = $emailArray;
        $mm->Subject = $subject;
        $mm->Body->Text = $text_body;
        $mm->Body->Html = $text_body;
        $mm->Options->IncludeOECustomHeaders = false;
		IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Incident: %s, Mailbox: %s", $incident->ID, $incident->Mailbox->ID));
    	if ($incident->Mailbox && $incident->Mailbox->ID) {
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Setting Mailbox: %s", $incident->Mailbox->ID));
    		$mm->FromMailbox = RNCPHP\ServiceMailBox::fetch($incident->Mailbox->ID);
    	}
        $mm->send();

        return true;
    }

	// good response: <SOAP-ENV:Envelope xmlns:SOAP-ENV="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"><SOAP-ENV:Body>
	// <ns:GetAccounts_Output xmlns:ns="http://siebel.com/CustomUI"><ns:ErrorNumber>0</ns:ErrorNumber><ns:ErrorString>SUCCESS</ns:ErrorString>
	// <Accounts xmlns="http://www.siebel.com/xml/Account"><Account><AccountName>Mac's Pharmacy</AccountName><CustomerNumber>1804</CustomerNumber><SPSystemType>Pharmacy Management System</SPSystemType><Status>Customer</Status><ChatFlag> </ChatFlag></Account>
	// <Account><AccountName>Mac's Edgemoor Pharmacy</AccountName><CustomerNumber>12630</CustomerNumber><SPSystemType>Pharmacy Management System</SPSystemType><Status>Customer</Status><ChatFlag> </ChatFlag></Account></Accounts>
	// </ns:GetAccounts_Output></SOAP-ENV:Body></SOAP-ENV:Envelope>
	// error response: <SOAP-ENV:Envelope xmlns:SOAP-ENV="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"><SOAP-ENV:Body>
	// <ns:GetAccounts_Output xmlns:ns="http://siebel.com/CustomUI"><ns:ErrorNumber>100</ns:ErrorNumber>
	// <ns:ErrorString>Sorry! The email address entered is not associated with an active customer in the system. Please contact Customer Service for assistance.</ns:ErrorString>
	// <Accounts xmlns="http://www.siebel.com/xml/Account"></Accounts></ns:GetAccounts_Output></SOAP-ENV:Body></SOAP-ENV:Envelope>Array
    public static function getAccounts($email, $customer_number, $is_login)
    {
    	IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("getAccounts: email: %s, custnum: %s", $email, $customer_number));
		$xml_request = self::getSoapTop() . "<soapenv:Body>
				  <cus:GetAccounts_Input>
					 <cus:Email>$email</cus:Email>
					 <!--Optional:-->
					 <cus:Customer_spcNumber>$customer_number</cus:Customer_spcNumber>
				  </cus:GetAccounts_Input>
			   </soapenv:Body>
			</soapenv:Envelope>";
		try {
			$xml_response = self::sendSoapRequest('GetAccounts', $xml_request, $customer_number);
		}
		catch (Exception $e) {
			return array("error_number" => "10000", "error_string" => $e->getMessage() . " Please contact the call center.");
		}
		if (empty($xml_response)) {
			return array("error_number" => "10000", "error_string" => "Oops! Something went wrong. Please wait a moment and try again. If the problem continues, contact Customer Service for assistance.");
		}
		//echo "request: $xml_request";
    	//echo "\nresponse: $xml_response";
		//logMessage("request: $xml_request");
		//logMessage("response: $xml_response");
// if Siebel is down we get the following error
// <SOAP-ENV:Envelope xmlns:SOAP-ENV="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"><SOAP-ENV:Body><SOAP-ENV:Fault><faultcode>SOAP-ENV:Server</faultcode><faultstring>Error Code: 10879185 Error Message: Error: Login failed attempting to connect to siebel.TCPIP.None.None://SEATST002:2321/SBA_TEST/EAIObjMgr_enu</faultstring><detail><siebelf:errorstack xmlns:siebelf="http://www.siebel.com/ws/fault"><siebelf:error><siebelf:errorsymbol /><siebelf:errormsg>Error: Login failed attempting to connect to siebel.TCPIP.None.None://SEATST002:2321/SBA_TEST/EAIObjMgr_enu</siebelf:errormsg></siebelf:error></siebelf:errorstack></detail></SOAP-ENV:Fault></SOAP-ENV:Body></SOAP-ENV:Envelope>
		$error_regex = '/<ns:ErrorNumber>(?P<error_number>.*?)<\/ns:ErrorNumber>\s*<ns:ErrorString>(?P<error_string>.*?)<\/ns:ErrorString>/si';
		preg_match($error_regex, $xml_response, $error_matches);
		//print_r($error_matches);
		if (($error_matches['error_number']) && ($error_matches['error_number'] != "0")) {
			return $error_matches;
		}

		preg_match('/<IsAdmin>(?P<is_admin>.*?)<\/IsAdmin>/si', $xml_response, $is_admin_match);
		if ($is_admin_match) {
			$is_admin = $is_admin_match['is_admin'];
		}
		//$is_admin = "Y";
		preg_match_all('/<Account>(?P<account>.*?)<\/Account>/i', $xml_response, $accounts);
		//print_r($accounts['account']);
		
		// somehow we were allowing create accounts without any siebel accounts, so if there is not any Siebel accounts 
		// we must make sure they have at least one account
		if ((!$accounts['account']) || (count($accounts['account']) < 1)) {
			if ($is_login) {	
				// if it is a login we must return 10000 so we know to let it go ahead and log in
				return array("error_number" => "10000", "error_string" => "Oops! Something went wrong. Please wait a moment and try again. If the problem continues, contact Customer Service for assistance.");
			}
			else {
				return array("error_number" => "11000", "error_string" => "Oops! Something went wrong. Please contact Customer Service for assistance.");
			}
		}
		
		foreach ($accounts['account'] as $account_string)
		{
			preg_match('/<AccountName>(?P<name>.*?)<\/AccountName>/si', $account_string, $matches);
			$new_match['name'] = $matches['name'];
			preg_match('/<ChatFlag>(?P<no_chat>.*?)<\/ChatFlag>/si', $account_string, $matches);
			$new_match['no_chat'] = $matches['no_chat'];
			preg_match('/<CustomerNumber>(?P<customer_number>.*?)<\/CustomerNumber>/si', $account_string, $matches);
			$new_match['customer_number'] = $matches['customer_number'];
			preg_match('/<SPSystemType>(?P<sp_system_type>.*?)<\/SPSystemType>/si', $account_string, $matches);
			$new_match['sp_system_type'] = $matches['sp_system_type'];
			preg_match('/<Status>(?P<siebel_status>.*?)<\/Status>/si', $account_string, $matches);
			$new_match['siebel_status'] = $matches['siebel_status'];
			$new_match['is_admin'] = $is_admin;
			$return_accounts[] = $new_match;
		}
		
		foreach ($return_accounts as $tmp_account)
		{
			if ($tmp_account['sp_system_type'] == "Pharmacy Management System")
			{
				$sorted_accounts[] = $tmp_account;
			}
		}
		foreach ($return_accounts as $tmp_account)
		{
			if ($tmp_account['sp_system_type'] == "Workflow Management System")
			{
				$sorted_accounts[] = $tmp_account;
			}
		}
		foreach ($return_accounts as $tmp_account)
		{
			if ($tmp_account['sp_system_type'] == "Standalone")
			{
				$sorted_accounts[] = $tmp_account;
			}
		}
		//logMessage("accounts: ".print_r($sorted_accounts, true));
		//print_r($return_accounts);
		return $sorted_accounts;
    }

	public static function sendSoapRequest($soapAction, $xml_request, $customer_number)
	{
		try {
			$url = RNCPHP\Configuration::fetch( 'CUSTOM_CFG_SIEBEL_URL' )->Value;
        	load_curl();
			$ch = curl_init();
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 0);

			$headers = array();
			array_push($headers, "Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8");
			array_push($headers, "Accept: text/xml");
			array_push($headers, "Cache-Control: no-cache");
			array_push($headers, "Pragma: no-cache");
			array_push($headers, "SOAPAction: \"document/http://siebel.com/CustomUI:$soapAction\"");
			if($xml_request != null) {
				curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, "$xml_request");
				array_push($headers, "Content-Length: " . strlen($xml_request));
			}
			//curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERPWD, "user_name:password"); /* If required */
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
			curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
			//curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_HEADER, false); 
			$response = curl_exec($ch);
			$code = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("xml_request: %s", $xml_request));
			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("Curl error: %s", curl_error($ch)));
			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("code: %s", $code));
			//IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("response: %s", $response));
			//echo 'Curl error: ' . curl_error($ch);
			//echo "response: " . $response;
			//echo "code: " . $code;
			if ($code != 200)		// need to catch errors
			{
				//$this->sendSiebelExceptionEmail($soapAction, $xml_request, curl_error($ch)."<br/>Code: $code<br/>Response: $response", $customer_number);
			}
			curl_close($ch);

			//print_r($response);
			$soap_regex = '/<SOAP-ENV:Envelope.*<\/SOAP-ENV:Envelope>/si';
			preg_match($soap_regex, $response, $matches);
			if (count($matches) != 1)
			{
				//$this->sendSiebelExceptionEmail($soapAction, $xml_request, "<br/>Response: $response", $customer_number);
				return null;
			}
			//print_r($matches[0]);
			$soap_response = $matches[0];	
		}
		catch (Exception $e) {
			//$this->sendSiebelExceptionEmail($soapAction, $xml_request, $e->getMessage()."\nCode: $code\nResponse: $response", $customer_number);
		}
		return $soap_response;
	}

	public static function createUpdateOrg($name, $customer_number, $no_chat, $sp_system_type, $siebel_status) {
		try{
			$orgId = self::getOrgId($customer_number);
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("createUpdateOrg orgId: %s", $orgId));
			//echo "orgId: $orgId";
			if ($orgId) 
			{
				$theOrg = RNCPHP\Organization::fetch($orgId);
				if ($theOrg->CustomFields->c->is_manual == 1) {
					if ($theOrg->CustomFields->c->no_chat != $no_chat) {
						$theOrg->CustomFields->c->no_chat = $no_chat;
						$theOrg->save(RNCPHP\RNObject::SuppressAll);  // make sure we don't run the business rules
					}
					return $orgId;		// now we always update the the org to force a business rule run, unless the org is manual
				}
			}
			else
			{
				$theOrg = new RNCPHP\Organization();
			}
			if (strlen($name) > 80) {
				$name = substr($name, 0, 80);
			}
			$theOrg->Name = $name;
			$theOrg->Login = $customer_number;
			
			$md = $theOrg::getMetadata();
			$cf_type_name = $md->CustomFields->type_name;
			$md2 = $cf_type_name::getMetadata();
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c = new $md2->c->type_name;
		 
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->customer_number = $customer_number;
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->no_chat = $no_chat;
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->is_manual = 0;			// always default is manual to false
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->sp_system_type->LookupName = $sp_system_type;
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->siebel_status->LookupName = $siebel_status;
			$theOrg->CustomFields->c->force_update = 1;			// always force an update to run the business rules
	
			$theOrg->save();
			return $theOrg->ID;
		}
		catch (Exception $err ){
			//echo $err->getMessage();
			IncidentAutomation_Utils::out($logger, sprintf("createUpdateOrg Exception: %s", $err->getMessage()));
		}
	}

	public static function getOrgId($customer_number)
    {
        try{
            $query = RNCPHP\ROQL::query(sprintf("SELECT ID FROM Organization WHERE CustomFields.c.customer_number='%s'", $customer_number))->next();
        }
        catch(RNCPHP\ConnectAPIErrorBase $e){
            throw $e;
        }
		$result = false;
        if($row = $query->next()){
            $result = intval($row['ID']);
        }
        return $result;
    }
